description: Phase 1 UI: Reflection Mode toggle in Settings + Pattern Interrupt push notifications with in-app banner fallback. Implements the full Phase 1 user-facing features including the challenger mode notice on analysis results and the pattern interrupt inbox banner.
steps: Create src/hooks/useReflectionMode.ts - react-query hook that reads profiles.reflection_mode from supabase (select from profiles where id=user.id), exposes { mode, setMode, isLoading }. setMode does optimistic update, persists to profiles table, invalidates query on success, rolls back + shows toast on failure.

Create src/components/app/ReflectionModeCard.tsx - shadcn RadioGroup with companion/challenger options inside a GlassCard. Uses useReflectionMode hook. Shows description text for each mode. Gated behind useFeatureFlag('reflection_mode').
Add ReflectionModeCard to src/pages/app/Settings.tsx after the billing card section.

Create src/components/app/ChallengerNotice.tsx - a small dismissible Alert component that shows 'Challenger mode active - distortions named directly' when analysis.reflection_mode === 'challenger'. Dismissal stored in sessionStorage keyed by analysis ID.
Add ChallengerNotice to the analysis result display in Dashboard.tsx (after the result renders) and in Journal.tsx (in the done phase).

Extend supabase/functions/compute-patterns/index.ts to add a second pattern computation block for distortion_recurrence: for each user, scan last 7 journal_analysis rows within rolling 14-day window, count distortion labels, upsert user_patterns rows with pattern_type='distortion_recurrence' when any distortion appears in >=3 of the 7 analyses.

Extend supabase/functions/fire-pattern-interrupts/index.ts to handle pattern_type='distortion_recurrence': on hourly tick, find matching patterns not fired in rate-limit windows (1 per 24h, 3 per 7d), check notification_preferences.pattern_interrupt_channel, for push users with validated push_subscriptions call send-push-notification with <=180 char body referencing distortion by name (no plaintext from entries). For banner-only or free-tier users, write to pattern_interrupt_inbox table instead.

Update src/components/app/PatternInterruptsCard.tsx to use the new pattern_interrupt_channel column instead of just pattern_interrupts_enabled. Show radio options: Push notifications / In-app banners only / Off. Use the i18n t() function for labels.

Create src/components/app/PatternInterruptBanner.tsx - reads pattern_interrupt_inbox for current user (where dismissed_at is null and expires_at > now()), renders a top-of-page dismissible banner with the distortion label and reframe body. On dismiss, updates dismissed_at.
Mount PatternInterruptBanner in src/components/app/AppShell.tsx so it appears on all authenticated pages.
Add relevant i18n keys to src/locales/en-US.json for all new UI strings (reflection mode labels, pattern interrupt messages, challenger notice text).
acceptance_criteria: Settings page shows Reflection Mode card with companion/challenger radio toggle
Changing reflection mode persists to profiles table and applies to next analysis
Challenger mode analysis results show a dismissible notice
Pattern interrupt banner appears when there are unread items in pattern_interrupt_inbox
Banner can be dismissed and stays dismissed
All new UI strings come from i18n layer (no hardcoded strings in components)
verification: Run npm run build and confirm zero errors
Run npm run test and confirm tests pass
